name: socialcue
description: Social Cue - find social-media conversations worth joining for your brands, on the Claude subscription you already have. Runs /socialdiscovery against your own logged-in local browser, scores conversations with a shared relevance brain, and writes ranked opportunities + drafted replies to a local store you review. On Pro, approve a reply and Claude can click submit for you; scheduling original posts through your own Postiz account is opt-in.
